target_policy.supplemental_anchor_policy: The 17 supplemental M3IB rows add reviewed hand and diagnostic table-union labels only. They do not add learned face/body anchors and do not change fixed-anchor authority.
target_policy.table_union_policy: The table_two_hand_union_or_contact_region payload remains diagnostic-only, derived from manual hand boxes where present, and cannot be used as promoted Detector 0 target authority.

fixed_baseline_beat_it_gate.gate_policy: A learned Detector 0 may not be called an improvement, exported, promoted, browser-activated, or used for claim language unless retraining beats both fixed-box held-out hand IoU baselines and then trends toward the spec gates.
fixed_baseline_beat_it_gate.until_gate_met: Claim surfaces stay fail-closed and the fixed-geometry baseline remains the operative detector policy.

gap_inventory.current_evidence: M3ID contains 49 included reviewed PopSign hand/upper-body rows and one excluded insufficient-visual-evidence row. It does not contain approved hard-negative no-hand examples.
gap_inventory.missing_evidence: Reviewed source-approved rows where no hand should be detected, with explicit absence labels for both learned hand targets and provenance tying each row to an approved source route.
gap_inventory.minimum_future_acceptance_proof: A tracked source-review and annotation receipt must enumerate hard-negative/no-hand row count, source ids, splits, absence payloads for left_or_first_hand and right_or_second_hand, reviewer identity, no-pretrained attestation, and JSON parse/hash evidence.
gap_inventory.allowed_source_provenance_route: Use first-party consented captures or source-register-approved hard-negative public-domain/raw-video sources after source review; project-authored manual absence labels are allowed when visual evidence and rights are recorded.
forbidden_shortcuts: treating the excluded insufficient-visual-evidence row as a no-hand negative
using pretrained detector, landmark, segmentation, or generated-label outputs
importing unreviewed media or derived pose/feature artifacts
hand-waving no-hand evidence from positive PopSign rows

gap_inventory.current_evidence: No tracked M3ID row represents an intentionally empty camera frame or empty practice scene.
gap_inventory.missing_evidence: Approved empty-camera frames or retained local browser fixtures with explicit no-hand/no-trigger expected outputs and provenance.
gap_inventory.minimum_future_acceptance_proof: A receipt must list empty-camera rows, hashes, split assignment or fixture role, expected absence payloads, and a local evaluator result proving Detector 0 does not fire on them.
gap_inventory.allowed_source_provenance_route: Use first-party consented local captures or local synthetic empty-browser fixtures only if the fixture source and non-media provenance are explicitly recorded in repo policy.
forbidden_shortcuts: claiming empty-camera coverage from ordinary positive rows
uploading raw learner video
using unapproved stock or web media
lowering browser claim gates without empty-camera proof

gap_inventory.current_evidence: The M3ID packet does not classify any reviewed row as low-light coverage and does not include a low-light challenge receipt.
gap_inventory.missing_evidence: Reviewed low-light rows or fixtures with source rights, expected hand/no-hand labels, and coverage across relevant splits or an explicitly bounded robustness challenge set.
gap_inventory.minimum_future_acceptance_proof: A tracked receipt must identify low-light rows, lighting condition, source approval, labels, hashes, and low-light Detector 0 metric results separate from standard-light results.
gap_inventory.allowed_source_provenance_route: Use first-party consented low-light captures or existing source-approved raw frames manually reviewed for low-light condition and label validity.
forbidden_shortcuts: simulating low light by mutating tensors without a tracked challenge policy
calling ordinary PopSign rows low-light without review
using pretrained enhancement or detector outputs as label authority

gap_inventory.current_evidence: M3ID materializes per-frame target payloads but no temporal sequence evaluator, jitter metric, or retained stability report.
gap_inventory.missing_evidence: A defined temporal jitter metric over consecutive or near-consecutive frames, with accepted thresholds and evaluator receipts for learned hand predictions.
gap_inventory.minimum_future_acceptance_proof: A local evaluator receipt must define the jitter statistic, input rows/sequences, baseline comparison, threshold, and pass/fail result for Detector 0 outputs.
gap_inventory.allowed_source_provenance_route: Use approved sequential frames from PopSign or first-party captures, preserving source split and signer boundaries.
forbidden_shortcuts: using single-frame IoU as temporal stability proof
smoothing outputs and reporting only smoothed metrics without raw jitter evidence
using pretrained trackers or landmark stabilizers

gap_inventory.current_evidence: The fixed-baseline gate records held-out thresholds left_or_first_hand > 0.4073 and right_or_second_hand > 0.6476. The prior shortcut learned bake-off did not beat the fixed baseline in 0 of 12 seeds.
gap_inventory.missing_evidence: A retrained scratch Detector 0 held-out test receipt where learned left and right hand IoU both strictly exceed the fixed-box thresholds.
gap_inventory.minimum_future_acceptance_proof: A retained evaluation receipt must include trained artifact hash, exact train/validation/test split, learned left hand IoU > 0.4073, learned right hand IoU > 0.6476, fixed-baseline comparison, and no-pretrained dependency proof.
gap_inventory.allowed_source_provenance_route: Train and evaluate from source-approved human/project-authored box labels only, after the packet has the negative/challenge coverage required above.
forbidden_shortcuts: calling Detector 0 improved from train IoU or validation-only wins
promoting if only one hand beats baseline
using pretrained backbones, detectors, landmarks, or generated labels
exporting or activating a learned artifact before both held-out hand thresholds are beaten

blocking_evidence_requirements: empty-camera rows or approved equivalent fixtures
low-light challenge rows or approved equivalent fixtures
preserved target policy and source provenance
false no-hand and false trigger rates
fixed-baseline beat-it comparison for both learned hands
Detector 0 evaluation metrics meeting or trending to spec
reviewer-grade receipts tied to exact artifacts
claim matrix update by approved tooling

readiness_classification.reason: The tracked evidence now states the blocking gaps, but it does not add hard-negative/no-hand, empty-camera, low-light, jitter, recall, false no-hand, false trigger, browser latency, or held-out baseline-beating evidence.
